review_description: GenR8 provided the best quote both in value and satisfying our requirement for reliable 3 phase power. With 24 kWH battery support and Sigenergy Gateway that provides UPS level power. Their installation was completed in a timely fashion, especially when allowing for the Tassie weather and out intermittent rainy days. We are especially happy with the neat installation and the savings in our power bills assured. We are also glad we used Solar Quotes to locate the best service in our region.

Advice, quotation, capacity to adjust quote to accommodate a bigger system, smooth installation and explanation of the system and monitoring app were all done very well. Inspection by relevant safety authority passed. System functioning well, with the projected and actual power generation being close for June.

Sales was great. The owner Nathan came out and discussed all options, he really knew his stuff being an electrician in the industry for years, not just a doorknocking salesman. He wasn't pushy at all, spent extra time to answer my questions.He had already visited my home before the other who companies even contacted me from solarquotes enquiry,He even gave me free advise about other electrical things in our new home before i had signed a thing.I ended up doing a lot research and going with Goodwe and Aiko combo, It was cheaper, has the same warranty, The Aiko panels are newer tech for a cheaper price.While i will consider a battery in the future the thought of paying fronius an extra $1000 to unlock a function in an already expensive (and by then 5 year old) inverter turned me off, I'd rather put that $1000 towards a new powerwall with built in inverter in 5 years time.With this in mind I choose the Goodwe, it has the same 10 year warranty, is half the price and performs the same or better than the fronius. All reports I read online suggest thousands installed with no issue.Install was great, 5 guys working hard all day to get it done and online by 4PM on the same day, The price also included the Catch solar relay which was all set up and working within minutes and comes with a great App to track your systems production and usage.The only downside to Genr8? The 8-10 week lead time due to how popular they are!2 days after the install (Today) was the first sunny day and the system produced 79KWH today.
Very pain free and clear communication in the process, if we increase the size of our system or add batteries well use them to do it.

The whole process from quoting, installing, commissioning and office support was second to none.The communication and workmanship on site could not be faulted.The whole Gener8 team were marvellous.I’ll certainly be recommending them to friends and family.
From getting our quote until the install was complete, every person we dealt with was vey helpful. It made our experience a very good one and helped us with the unknown of going with solar.

We had three installers quote for us, GenR8 were genuine and friendly in the process; our roof was supposedly Tin tiled sheets, which meant any drilling or cutting into it could cause a tear easily and a leak would develop so it was ill advised to work on the current roof system and replace it with Colourbond corrugated or common tiles(which the cost would far out weigh the saving of solar) When GenR8 Electrical came out to quote, they spent some time discussing this problem then after some discussion, asked to get onto the roof just to assess the roof would need replacing and when we got on the roof it became evident that the roof was actually galvanised metal and would handle solar framing install without leak as assumed. This, coupled with the friendly and open advice; along with the reasonable price made us feel comfortable with choosing them for our solar system.All the research into the three types of solar packages was difficult; as to know what was the right decision was tough because marketing ploys and statistics being used to make any product look great, I felt confused but GenR8 did give us confidence to make a decision.The install was done in one day and we were producing solar electricity the next day. Just professional great service.

SolarQuotes contacted three suppliers in Tasmania on our behalf. Within a day or so of being advised of the prospective suppliers Karl and Nathan from GenR8 Electrical visited our premises and provided an obligation free quote as requested. They spent over an hour discussing solar systems to establish what would be best suit our needs promising to get a formal quote to us within a couple of days. The quote arrived later that evening. Whilst evaluating the three quotes received we went back to them for clarification on a couple of matters and received a revised quote within 24 hours specifying everything we had asked for, in particular a prospective installation date.They arrived to install the equipment a couple of days before we expected them but only after ensuring it was suitable to us. The majority of the installation was completed on the first day with the panels to be installed on the next day. The next day the weather was pretty wild but they completed the job as promised fortunately as on subsequent days the weather was considerably worse.The system was commissioned and has worked flawlessly since that date.GenR8 Electrical, South Spreyton is a small local company who provide excellent customer service and installation as well as competitive pricing.I have no hesitation in recommending them to friends or anyone else looking for solar in NW Tasmania.

We got three quotes via SolarQuotes and a couple of others by direct enquiry.  GenR8 provided us with competitive quotes for a range of systems involving different sizes and quality of components to allow me to decide which scenario would be most cost effective for us.  They were also the only supplier among those we contacted who preferred to visit us onsite and assess our situation before quoting rather than work through photographs, phone call and email.A big plus for us was that this was a local installer and that the two electricians who run the business and perform the installation are also the ones who you deal with from initial contact, not an intermediary sales person.  They have a Facebook site showing the installations they have completed, so you can judge their past work.  They listened to our questions and provided us with helpful advice based on their experience, but did not pressure us into choosing one option over another.  I chose a 3kw inverter and 4.6 kw of panels, not wishing to overinvest in light of Tamania's southerly latitude and very cloudy winters with short days, not expecting the panels actual output to exceed the inverter's capacity except for a few hours each day on sunny summer days.Once we accepted the quote, the whole process went smoothly from that point, although we did have to wait 3 months from quote acceptance until installation date.  We were very pleased with the quality of the installation work and the focus on doing the job well (eg positioning the inverter in the best location for shading, not close to the fusebox).  The system has been operating for four weeks now and the network power company installed our new meter to record our solar feed in two days ago.  The solar analytics monitoring is very helpful in allowing me to follow production and consumption as we use different appliances and the system output looks good.On a sunny day in the longest day length month of the year we have been generating 25kwh per day, maxing out the inverter at 3kw between 9.00am and 2.30 pm.  On our one day so far of rain and dull cloud, production dropped below 4kwh for the day, so it remains to be seen whether our solar system will give us very much useful production through our wet winter, short day length months.Overall, I am very pleased with our choice of GenR8 for the installation of our solar system and would heartily recommend them.
